title: Essential Verb - {faire} (to do/make)
description: Master the most versatile French verb through active recall and composition practice!
can_do: Express doing and making (I do, you make, they do)
Talk about activities and tasks in French
Use faire in common expressions and daily activities

concepts.definition: Extremely versatile verb - doing actions and making things
concepts.example: Used constantly in daily life - one of the top 15 words!

concepts.definition: faire is irregular - but you've seen a pattern like this before!
concepts.example: je fais, tu fais, il fait, elle fait, are all the same sounding, but different spellings. Nous faisons, vous faites, ils font, elles font are like the other irregular verbs you've learned. Easy!

concepts.definition: Combine faire with previous modules for infinite expressions
concepts.example: {je fais + ça, nous faisons + le travail, ils font + attention}

items.situation: Say what you do

mistakes.feedback: Je takes '{fais}', not 'fait'. Remember: je fais, il fait
That's 'you do', not 'I do'. Focus on the pronoun!

items.situation: Say what you do

mistakes.feedback: Tu takes '{fais}', not 'fait'. Pattern: je fais, tu fais

items.situation: Say what he does

mistakes.feedback: Il takes '{fait}', not 'fais'. Remember: il fait, elle fait

items.situation: Say what she does

mistakes.feedback: Elle takes '{fait}', not 'fais'. Same as il fait

items.situation: Say what we do

mistakes.feedback: Nous takes '{faisons}', not 'fais'. Unique form!
Nous takes '{faisons}', not 'fait'. Completely different!

items.situation: Say what you do (formal)

mistakes.feedback: Vous takes '{faites}', not 'fais'. Another unique form!
Vous takes '{faites}', not 'fait'. Remember: vous faites

items.situation: Say what they do (masculine)

mistakes.feedback: Ils takes '{font}', not 'fais'. Completely irregular!
Ils takes '{font}', not 'fait'. Very irregular form!

items.situation: Say what they do (feminine)

mistakes.feedback: Elles takes '{font}', not 'fais'. Same as ils font
Elles takes '{font}', not 'fait'. Very irregular!

items.situation: Say what you do with that

mistakes.feedback: Je takes '{fais}', not 'fait'. Remember: je fais, il fait

items.answer: qu'est-ce que tu fais avec ça?

mistakes.feedback: More common: qu'est-ce que tu fais avec ça?

items.situation: Say what he does with that

mistakes.feedback: Il takes '{fait}', not 'fais'. Remember: il fait, elle fait

items.situation: Say what we do with that

mistakes.feedback: Nous takes '{faisons}', not 'fais'. Unique form!

mistakes.feedback: This needs vouloir! Try: que veux-tu faire?

items.situation: Say what you want to do

mistakes.feedback: This needs vouloir! Try: je veux faire ça
